shared_elements: curvilinear figural motifs with large eye
justification: Both surfaces bear low-relief anthropomorphic imagery with prominent staring eyes rendered as bold curvilinear forms, but A shows a few isolated, heavily schematic mask/creature motifs scattered over an irregular boulder with no scene structure, while B presents a densely composed panel of standing costumed figures with elaborate headdresses, held objects, an attendant, and blocks of sign-like glyphs. The compositional logic, figural completeness and level of detail are wholly different, so only the most generic correspondence (relief faces with big eyes) holds.
